description: This file defines the internal utility class FastMathCalc used for advanced mathematical calculations, such as trigonometric functions, exponentials, logarithms, and their extended-precision implementations, in the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: FastMathCalc
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for the computation of various mathematical functions using extended precision techniques, including sine, cosine, exponential, and logarithmic functions.

methods.name: buildSinCosTables
methods.description: Builds sine, cosine, and tangent lookup tables using Taylor series approximations and angle addition formulas.

methods.name: slowCos
methods.description: Calculates cosine of a given angle using Taylor series expansion, with extended precision support.

methods.name: slowSin
methods.description: Calculates sine of a given angle using Taylor series expansion, with extended precision support.

methods.name: slowexp
methods.description: Calculates exponential of a given number using extended precision.

methods.name: slowLog
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of a number using an approximation based on a Remez polynomial.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a double into two parts with reduced precision for extended precision arithmetic.

methods.name: resplit
methods.description: Resplits a number in extended precision form to maintain the split representation.

methods.name: splitMult
methods.description: Computes the product of two split numbers, resulting in extended precision.

methods.name: splitAdd
methods.description: Adds two split numbers, maintaining extended precision.

methods.name: splitReciprocal
methods.description: Calculates the reciprocal of a number in split extended precision form.

methods.name: quadMult
methods.description: Multiplies two numbers in extended precision using split parts.

methods.name: expint
methods.description: Calculates e raised to an integer power in extended precision.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a double value into a string, handling NaN and sign.

methods.name: printarray
methods.description: Prints a 1D or 2D array of doubles as C-style initializer lists, primarily for generating lookup tables.
